description.narrative:
Stakeholder effects Increased access to finance to women microenterprises: Through this Project, IFCs investment is anticipated to support IIX with on-lending to MFIs and NBFIs which would in turn increase their lending to women micro-enterprises, thereby increasing access to financing for this segment.
Competitiveness: IFC anticipates that the Project will increase competitive pressures among credit funds in Asia by driving innovation and replication of WLB7s (i) approach of integrating a gender-lens and embedding sustainability principles in its investment process and (ii) strategy of targeting small to mid-sized NBFIs and MFIs that target underserved women microenterprises and individuals. Through innovation and demonstration channels, the proposed Project seeks to encourage more credit funds to apply a gender-lends approach to its investing and to target financial institutions that primarily cater to underserved women, helping increase the access to finance of these underserved women borrowers.

The proposed project is an investment of up to US$34.5 million comprising: (i) a subscription of up to US$30 million in senior bonds to be issued by WLB VII Asset Pte. Ltd. (WLB7); and (ii) a mezzanine loan of up to US$4.5 million to the IIX Womens Catalyst Fund (WCF) by Blended Finance through Canada-IFC Advancing Gender Equality, Resilience, Opportunity and Inclusion Worldwide Facility (Canada GROW) (the Project). WLB7 will make gender-focused investments in sectors such as MSME lending, clean-energy lending, agriculture, and water and sanitation. The use of proceeds will be towards on-lending to underserved women borrowers, particularly women-owned micro and small enterprises. WCF is a de-risking facility that provides catalytic first-loss capital for the Womens Livelihood Bond (WLB) Series. The full amount of the mezzanine loan provided to WCF will be used exclusively to support the loans under the WLB7 issuance. WLB7 and WCF will be managed by the Impact Investment Exchange (IIX or the Fund Manager), a Singapore-based investment manager that operates various platforms to support impact-oriented enterprises with social missions in sectors such as agriculture, clean technology, renewable energy, education, healthcare and microfinance.
